tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.createMultipleReason: Creating several tasks at once is planned.

display.note: Sorting never changes the run queue.

menu.noTagsReason: Create tags on a task's page first.
menu.runNotEnded: A run of this task has not ended. Done and Canceled stop it, after you confirm.

refused.title: {{task}} can't move to {{column}}
refused.runNotEnded: A run of this task has not ended. Answer or stop it from the task, or wait for it to end.
refused.runNotEndedMenu: A run of this task has not ended.
refused.incomplete: Add the missing details before running the task.
refused.hasRun: This task already has a run.
refused.pipeline: Columns by pipeline only show where tasks are; a task's pipeline is chosen on its page.
refused.closeHint: Done or Canceled stop it, after you confirm.

startsNow.one: Queue {{task}}? It starts now: 1 agent slot is free.
startsNow.other: Queue {{task}}? It starts now: {{count}} agent slots are free.
startsNow.detail: It runs on {{pipeline}} from its first step.

runAgain.title: Run {{task}} again?
runAgain.detail: A new run of {{task}} starts on {{pipeline}} from its first step. The last run stays in its history.

unmerged.title: Mark {{task}} as done without merging?
unmerged.detail: {{task}} is ready to merge. Marking it as done leaves its changes unmerged in their branch.

bulkQueue.one: Queue {{tasks}}? They start now: 1 agent slot is free.
bulkQueue.other: Queue {{tasks}}? They start now: {{count}} agent slots are free.
bulkQueue.detail: Each runs on its pipeline from its first step; those without a free slot wait their turn.

bulkUnmerged.title: Mark {{count}} tasks as done without merging?
bulkUnmerged.detail: Ready to merge: {{unmerged}}. Marking the tasks as done leaves those changes unmerged in their branches.

delete.title: Delete {{count}} tasks?
delete.detail: {{tasks}} are deleted with their runs, conversations and worktrees. This can't be undone.

bulkDone.title: Stop {{runs}} runs and mark {{count}} tasks as done?
bulkDone.detail: The runs of {{running}} have not ended; they stop. {{tasks}} are marked as done.

bulkCanceled.title: Stop {{runs}} runs and cancel {{count}} tasks?
bulkCanceled.detail: The runs of {{running}} have not ended; they stop. {{tasks}} are canceled.

bulk.allThere: Every selected task is already there.

empty.title: No tasks
empty.detail: Drop a card here to move it to {{column}}.

noMatch.title: No match
noMatch.one: {{column}} has {{count}} task the search or filters hide.
noMatch.other: {{column}} has {{count}} tasks the search or filters hide.

hint.onlyClose: {{task}} goes only to Done or Canceled

quickAdd.label: Title
quickAdd.tooLong: A title has at most {{count}} characters.

loadError.title: Tasks cannot be read
loadError.body: Reading the task list from the project database failed. {{reason}} No task was changed. The list appears once it can be read.

empty.title: No tasks yet
empty.detail: A task is a piece of work a pipeline carries from brief to merge, in its own worktree.

noMatches.title: No tasks in this view match the search or filters.

inView.one: {{view}} has {{count}} task. Search looks at titles, keys and briefs.
inView.other: {{view}} has {{count}} tasks. Search looks at titles, keys and briefs.

emptyView.title: No tasks in this view.
emptyView.active: A task shows here once it is Todo, In progress or In review, or waits for you.
emptyView.backlog: A task shows here while its workflow status is Backlog.
emptyView.done: A task shows here once it is Done or Canceled.
emptyView.all: A task shows here once it is created.

outsideTasks.body: This list shows tasks only. The Needs you panel lists everything that waits for you.

shared.removedTitle: You're no longer a member of {{project}} on {{server}}
shared.removedBody: {{server}} answered at {{time}} that you aren't in {{project}} any more. This computer keeps {{key}}'s {{count}} tasks as they were then, read-only. Runs already going here finish; none can start. Make {{project}} local to keep working here, or ask an owner, {{owners}}, to add you again.

title.one: 1 task stayed on this computer when {{project}} joined {{key}}
title.other: {{count}} tasks stayed on this computer when {{project}} joined {{key}}

notShared.body: {{keys}} weren't ticked on {{day}}. They keep their key, runs, conversations and memory here, read-only and out of the shared list. Share task on a task's page uploads it to {{server}} with the next {{key}} number.
notShared.foundOne: {{key}} {{title}} stayed on this computer as Not shared.
notShared.foundMany: {{count}} tasks that match stayed on this computer as Not shared.
